description.title: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח מכלול
description.summary: This table outlines conditions related to currency exchange rates for insurance benefits and the prescription period for claims under the 'מכלול' policy. It details how sums insured and liabilities are calculated when denominated in currencies other than the policy's schedule currency.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתייחסת לתנאי פוליסת הביטוח 'מכלול' ומפרטת את אופן חישוב סכומי הביטוח ומגבלות האחריות במטבעות שונים, בהתאם לשער החליפין של בנק ישראל.  הטבלה רלוונטית לחישוב תגמולים המגיעים למבוטח או למוטב.  ניתן למצוא כאן מידע על תקופת ההתיישנות לתביעות ביטוח, הן בביטוח כללי והן בביטוח אחריות.  הטבלה עוסקת בחישוב סכומים המבוטאים בדולרים אמריקאים, וכן במטבעות אחרים ביחס למטבע המופיע בתוכנית הביטוח.  סכומי ביטוח, מגבלות אחריות, והשתתפות עצמית, תקופת התיישנות, ודולר ארה״ב הם מושגים מרכזיים בטבלה זו.  פוליסת 'מכלול' מציעה תנאים ספציפיים בנוגע לטיפול בתביעות ביטוח.
notable_values: Exchange rate source: Bank of Israel

13.2 If the sums insured or limits of liability and deductible are denominated in US dollars, same -including the insurance benefits due to the insured or the beneficiary (as the case may be) -shall be calculated in US dollars according to the representative rate of the dollar with the Bank of Israel, applying on the date of calculation or actual payment (as the case may be).
13.3 If the policy notes a sum insured, limit of liability or deductible sum in a currency other than that specified in the schedule, said sum shall be calculated in accordance with the representative exchange rate published by the Bank of Israel for such currency into the currency noted in the schedule on the date of the occurrence of the insured event.
14. Prescription
The prescription period for a claim for insurance benefits shall be three years from the date of the occurrence of the insured event.
In liability insurance, a claim for insurance benefits shall not prescribe as long as the third party's claim against the insured has not prescribed.

טבלה: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח מכלול
This table outlines conditions related to currency exchange rates for insurance benefits and the prescription period for claims under the 'מכלול' policy. It details how sums insured and liabilities are calculated when denominated in currencies other than the policy's schedule currency.
ממדים: Condition / Rule, Details of Condition

13.2 If the sums insured or limits of liability and deductible are denominated in US dollars, same -including the insurance benefits due to the insured or the beneficiary (as the case may be) -shall be calculated in US dollars according to the representative rate of the dollar with the Bank of Israel, applying on the date of calculation or actual payment (as the case may be).
13.3 If the policy notes a sum insured, limit of liability or deductible sum in a currency other than that specified in the schedule, said sum shall be calculated in accordance with the representative exchange rate published by the Bank of Israel for such currency into the currency noted in the schedule on the date of the occurrence of the insured event.
14. Prescription
The prescription period for a claim for insurance benefits shall be three years from the date of the occurrence of the insured event.
In liability insurance, a claim for insurance benefits shall not prescribe as long as the third party's claim against the insured has not prescribed.
